description: In front of you is an open brown cabinet shelf beside a toy dishwasher, with several clear plastic food containers and lids stored inside. The left hand reaches into the shelf, pulls out a small clear container and sets it on the tabletop, then removes another and places it nearby; it continues unstacking more containers one by one, sliding each out toward the front and arranging them in a row while the right hand stays mostly to the side without touching anything.
